inlines.v: EVENT', noun [Latin eventus, evenio; e and venio, to come.] 1. That which comes, arrives or happens; that which falls out; any incident good or bad. There is one event to the righteous and to the wicked. Ecclesiastes 9:2. 2. The consequence of any thing; the issue; conclusion; end; that in which an action, operation, or series of operations terminates. The event of the campaign was to being about a negotiation for peace. EVENT', verb intransitive To break forth. [Not used.]
